description: Non-material amendment to planning permission PP/25/05025 (Variation of Condition 2 (Compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission PP/21/05028 (Alterations at rear including extension at lower ground level; extension at ground floor level; creation of green wall; replacement of window with door at first floor level, alterations at front including installation of glazed fanlight and glazing bar, entrance light, house number and replacement of railings and gate with spear heads. Internal alterations including lowering at lower ground floor level and reconfiguration of layout) for alterations to consented scheme in response to changes required following design and interior design input) to incorporate alterations to lower ground floor, addition of new ground floor doorbell following relocation of w/c.
